title: As General-Purpose Models Get Stronger, What Should Embodied AI Teams Build?
subtitle: From Helix, π, and Gemini Robotics to System 0/1, agent coordination, and data feedback loops
summary: Advances in general cognition are reshaping the research boundaries of embodied AI teams. Examining approaches from Figure, PI, Gemini, Skild, and others, we discuss how to make System 2 replaceable, invest in reliable physical execution and system coordination, and use experiments to decide what to build ourselves.
